answer_1.quote: ...Multimodal summarization aims to generate summaries given the inputs of multiple modalities... We use 9 summarization models to generate summaries, including: (1) BART ... (9) GPT-4 with vision (OpenAI, 2023)...
answer_1.outputs: multimodal summary (text summary and selected images)

answer_2.quote: ...we evaluate the following baseline metrics: (1) lexical overlap metrics: ROUGE (R1, R2, ROUGE-L); BLEU; (2) pretrained language models: BERTScore; BARTScore; MoverScore; (3) LLM based metrics: GPTScore; G-Eval... For image score we evaluate Image Precision, MUSQ (Image), CLIPScore, caption‑based methods...

answer_3.quote: ...We propose mLLM-EVAL ... using multimodal LLMs ... We use GPT-4 with vision ("gpt-4-vision-preview") as the multimodal LLM. ... we design attribute‑specific prompts for the multimodal LLM to output the quality scores...

answer_4.quote: ...we ask three annotators to evaluate the quality of the multimodal summaries. All annotators are English native speakers ... We use a 1 to 5 rating scale for scoring... Before conducting the human annotation, we set guidelines for the annotators, which include the above evaluation attributes, as well as the instructions to avoid cognitive biases...
answer_4.guideline: Guidelines include evaluation attributes (text relevance, coherence, consistency, fluency; image quality; text‑image relevance; overall quality) and instructions to avoid anchoring, lead, and text bias.
